Italy Photo Gallery — first pass
Three sections, small thumbnails, and a full-image viewer with forward/back. Every tile is a placeholder — the coloured squares are where real photos go. Shown at phone width, in the app’s existing page styling, because that is exactly how students will see it.
Tap any thumbnail to open the viewer, then use the arrows, swipe, or the left/right keys. The “Videos” button top-right is the cross-link to the other page.
